meta.project: Converge - Centralized KYC Service for FinTech

product_overview: Converge is a centralized KYC (Know Your Customer) service designed for the FinTech ecosystem. It allows users to complete KYC verification once and share their verified status and credit information securely with multiple third-party lending platforms. The platform also provides tools for KYC document management, credit score calculation based on transaction history, and role-based access control to serve users, administrators, and partners effectively.
core_goals: Centralize KYC verification to eliminate redundant user submissions across lending platforms.
Enable secure, JWT-based authentication with password hashing and role-based access control.
Allow users to upload, manage, and submit identity documents for verification.
Provide administrators with tools to review, approve, or reject KYC submissions with audit trails.
Implement a CIBIL-style credit score calculation engine based on user transactions.
Support financial transaction management for users including adding, viewing, and filtering transactions.
Facilitate secure partner integration allowing third-party platforms to verify KYC status and retrieve credit data with user consent.
Ensure data security and privacy through best practices including JWT auth, encrypted passwords, and validated requests.
key_features: JWT-based user authentication with registration, login, profile management, and role-based access control.
KYC document upload supporting various ID types with file validation and size limits.
End-to-end KYC verification workflow allowing users to submit documents and admins to approve or reject with reasons.
Comprehensive credit score engine calculating scores between 300 and 900 using total transactions, transaction amount, credit/debit ratio, frequency, and recent activity.
User dashboard displaying KYC status, credit score, transaction summaries, and quick navigation to key features.
Admin panel providing a verification queue, document review capabilities, KYC application approval/rejection, and audit logging.
Transaction management including creation, viewing, pagination, and filtering of financial transactions, with automatic credit score updates.
OAuth-like partner integration enabling trusted third-party platforms to link accounts, verify KYC status, and access credit and transaction data securely.
Robust request validation middleware to ensure data integrity and prevent invalid submissions.
Global error handling middleware for consistent API error responses.
PostgreSQL database integration with secure connection and schema management.
Frontend React application with routing, navigation, and API client featuring token management and error handling.
user_flow_summary: Users register an account and securely authenticate via JWT tokens.
Users upload multiple identity documents (e.g., Aadhaar, PAN, Passport) with validation checks.
Users submit their uploaded documents for KYC review by administrators.
Administrators log in and view a verification queue of pending KYC requests.
Admins review documents and approve or reject applications, providing mandatory rejection reasons if applicable.
Users add financial transactions which update their credit score based on defined algorithm.
Users view their credit score, KYC status, and transaction summaries on a personalized dashboard.
Partners initiate OAuth-like account linking to gain access to user data with explicit user consent.
Partners verify KYC status and retrieve credit score and transaction history via secure API endpoints.
validation_criteria: User registration requires valid email, strong password, and mandatory user details.
Authentication enforces JWT token validity with role-based access control.
File uploads accept only allowed MIME types (PDF, JPG, PNG) and sizes up to 5MB.
KYC review actions by admins require mandatory reasons on rejection.
Transactions must include valid transaction types ('credit' or 'debit'), positive amounts, and properly formatted dates.
Credit score is correctly recalculated after each transaction addition and reflects the weighted scoring algorithm.
Partner API access requires valid API keys, JWT authorization tokens, and enforces rate limiting if enabled.
All API endpoints perform request data validation using express-validator middleware.
Global error handler consistently formats and returns errors for client consumption.
Role-based route protections prevent unauthorized access to user, admin, and partner features.
Database integrity is maintained through parameterized queries and consistent schemas.
Frontend client correctly manages authentication state, token storage, and error handling in all user interactions.

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: JWT-based authentication system with registration, login, and profile management. Includes password hashing with bcrypt and role-based access control.

features.name: KYC Document Management
features.description: Upload, manage, and review identity documents (Aadhaar, PAN, Passport, etc.) for KYC verification. Supports file uploads with validation and admin review workflow.

features.name: KYC Verification Workflow
features.description: Complete KYC submission and review process. Users can submit documents for review, and admins can approve or reject with mandatory reasons. Includes audit trail.

features.name: Transaction Management
features.description: Create, view, and manage financial transactions (credit/debit). Supports pagination, filtering, and automatic credit score recalculation on transaction addition.

features.name: Credit Score Calculation
features.description: CIBIL-style credit score engine (300-900 range) that calculates scores based on transaction history. Uses weighted algorithm considering total transactions, average amount, credit/debit ratio, frequency, and recent activity.

features.name: User Dashboard
features.description: Dashboard displaying KYC status, credit score, financial summary, and quick access to key features.

features.name: Admin Panel
features.description: Admin interface for reviewing pending KYC requests, viewing documents, and approving/rejecting applications with reasons.

features.name: Partner Integration
features.description: OAuth-like account linking system for third-party partners (e.g., Slice). Partners can verify KYC status and retrieve user credit scores and transaction history with user consent.

features.name: Role-Based Access Control
features.description: Middleware and components for enforcing role-based access (User, Admin, Partner). Protected routes and API endpoints based on user roles.

features.name: Request Validation
features.description: Middleware for validating request data using express-validator. Ensures data integrity and prevents invalid requests.

features.name: Error Handling
features.description: Global error handler middleware for consistent error responses across the API.

features.name: Database Configuration
features.description: PostgreSQL database connection and configuration management.

features.name: API Client
features.description: Frontend API client with axios for making HTTP requests to the backend. Includes token management and error handling.

features.name: Navigation Components
features.description: Navigation bar and routing components for the React application.

features.name: Server Entry Point
features.description: Express server initialization with middleware setup, route registration, and health check endpoint.
